title: Route incomplete create-file requests to Chat for clarification
goal: Prevent create-file requests missing an explicit content boundary from entering strict Skill execution; ask for clarification without weakening write verification.
context: PR #521 addresses the reported malformedSkill failure when the user sends only 'Tạo file'. The task contract is required by Agent Task Contract CI and scopes this focused change.
forbidden_changes: Do not modify unrelated chat routing or Skill execution behavior.
Do not change release tags, release assets, or Alpha/Stable release configuration.
Do not claim the physical-device bug is fixed without device verification.
acceptance_criteria: Create-file prompts without an explicit content boundary, including 'hãy tạo file hello.txt', return no Skill match and are handled as incomplete chat input.
A composition regression test covers the bare create-file prompt.
All changed files are within allowed_paths.
Required CI checks pass before the PR is considered mergeable.
verification: Run the relevant Swift test suite and inspect all required PR checks.
recovery: If scope validation or regression tests fail, preserve CI evidence and revise the task or implementation in a follow-up commit; do not bypass the contract gate.
